mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution (p > 0.05 for negative return prediction).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 200) over the 2000-2006 period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and fall in employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp AND PAYEMS fall > 100k) produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over the 2000-2006 period.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom (HOUST > 2000), strong residential demand conditions signal robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 2000 over the 2000-2006 period.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic supply conditions, which are associated with positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns as the economy avoids recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when INDPRO is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution (p > 0.05 for positive return prediction).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0) over the 2000-2006 period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential investment (RSAFS) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) signals a housing market correction, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1% in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 10% in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (RSAFS rise > 1% AND HOUST fall > 10%) produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases over the 2000-2006 period.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 110, it signals strong economic supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 110) over the 2000-2006 period.
